component_status.cmp: excluded because Distribution Stage1 V1 did not advance
component_status.competition_local: not a Layer2 replacement; retained only as an ensemble diversity candidate because its fixed-line binary LL improved across D1-D4 in V3
component_status.side_nb2_corners: validated binary-market component already selected in V2
component_status.similar_context_goals: weak mixed Layer3 signal but already selected as V2 ensemble diversifier

evaluation.advance_gate: selected regularized pool must improve Log Loss and Brier versus frozen V2 anchor with both 95% paired CI lower bounds >0, win Log Loss in at least 2/3 chronological validation folds, and have no fold Log Loss regression worse than 0.002
evaluation.primary: fixture-balanced binary Log Loss on chronological D2-D4 validation predictions
evaluation.uncertainty: paired UTC-calendar-week block bootstrap versus frozen V2 anchor

corners.fixture_objective: 50% SIDE and 50% TOTAL; SIDE gives HOME/AWAY equal weight; lines equal within scope
corners.scope: coherent side lines 2.5-7.5 plus total lines 7.5-12.5

optimizer.final_refit: after ridge selection, fit weights on all D1-D4 for later CALIBRATION stage; final-refit metrics are descriptive only
optimizer.objective: fixture-balanced binary Log Loss + ridge_lambda * squared Euclidean distance from frozen V2 anchor weights
optimizer.ridge_selection_metric: pooled chronological validation Log Loss over D2-D4
optimizer.selection: chronological expanding validation: fit D1 score D2; fit D1-D2 score D3; fit D1-D3 score D4
optimizer.solver: deterministic SLSQP initialized at frozen V2 anchor

purpose: Test a continuous regularized convex linear pool of validated/diversifying OOF components using chronological expanding-fold selection rather than coarse hand weight grids.

scientific_boundary.inputs: immutable DEVELOPMENT OOF/component artifacts plus frozen V2.1 competition-local DEVELOPMENT rows
